# Local rendering libraries

Vendored npm distributions, installed with lifecycle scripts disabled:
- marked 18.1.0 — https://marked.js.org/ (MIT)
- DOMPurify 3.4.16 — https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify (Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0)
- KaTeX 0.19.0 — https://katex.org/ (MIT; fonts included)

No CDN, runtime downloads, or model calls. Licenses are adjacent to these files.
